story: I’m an AI product manager who loves turning customer problems into lovable solutions.

My path has been unconventional. I started out as a digital transformation consultant, where my curiosity drew me to delve into how enterprises work: observing their workflows, spotting where they break and redesigning them with technology.

I’ve always been relentless about better-ing things, like asking, “How could i further make the workflow more efficient?” That question led me to AI. I moved from shaping strategies that improve workflows to delivering them as intelligent agentic platforms with humans in the loop.

Studying systems end to end raised an even bigger question: what if agents could act for people every day, not just for enterprises? That question drives my work today, building agentic AI products that are useful, trustworthy and centered around humans.
